quarterly_data.quarter: Victory Giant Technology investor Q&A: SZSE Interactive Easy (10-19-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The company said on SZSE Interactive Easy: Plant 4 is positioned as a high-end AI server PCB line and is in its mass-production ramp; shipment scale depends on customer timing and market demand. Orders on hand are ample, the company keeps expanding cooperation with other leading technology customers and is expanding its key bottleneck processes. It has R&D and mass-production capability for high-multilayer PCBs of more than 70 layers and a technology reserve for PCBs of more than 100 layers, used mainly in AI servers and high-end switches; mass-production timing of specific products depends on R&D progress and customer demand. It says product value keeps rising as PCB materials, line width / spacing, layer counts and build-up orders upgrade with downstream product iterations.
quarterly_data.figure: 70+ layer R&D and mass-production capability; 100+ layer technology reserve
